title: $550 million a month is moving through a platform you've probably never heard of.
caption:
$550 million a month is moving through a platform you've probably never heard of.

It's called Whop, and it's now worth $5.1 billion. About 25,000 operators run businesses on it, from invoicing software for trucking companies to emergency tree removal and private jet booking. Some are 16-year-old first-time founders.

In February, Tether put in $200M at a $1.6B valuation. This week, Sequoia and Shopify Ventures led another $200M at $5.1B.

Would you start a business on Whop?
